axiom_policy: Each selected theorem prints a Lean axiom report; acceptance requires no line saying it depends on axioms.
non_goals: a theorem about all theories or all abstractions
bare ZFC syntax, models, consistency, or inconsistency
HoTT-specific univalence, quotient, truncation, or HIT behavior
a reality, time, or process-completion verdict
a Gödel fixed point or proof-theoretic incompleteness theorem
scope: Abstract collision-to-no-decoder theorem plus finite Bool/Unit control and identity positive control.
theory_variant: Lean 4.34.1 core dependent type theory; abstract function/Prop observation factorization control; no Mathlib, ZFC syntax, or HoTT-specific rule
